title: Your Exchange Balance Is Not Money
hook: Your exchange balance is not money. It is an IOU.
question: Who actually holds your coins?

scenes.narration: The number on your exchange app is not money. It is an IOU.
When you buy on an exchange, the exchange holds the coins. You hold a claim, a promise they will pay you back.
scenes.sub: the exchange holds them — you hold a promise

scenes.narration: FTX customers found this out the hard way. Eight billion in claims, with the coins long gone.
scenes.label: of claims, no coins behind them

scenes.narration: Not your keys, not your coins. Who is really holding yours?
scenes.sub: not your keys, not your coins
